items.value: No, most thyroid nodules are benign and simply monitored with periodic ultrasound; surgery is considered only for certain high-risk features, large size, or confirmed cancer on biopsy.

items.value: Untreated hypothyroidism in pregnancy can affect both mother and baby, so it's monitored closely and treated promptly, usually by adjusting the levothyroxine dose.
